_meta.title: India State-Level Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries & GI Product Dataset
_meta.confidence_note: Crop seasons (Kharif/Rabi/Zaid) and major producing states are standard, well-documented facts (Ministry of Agriculture, NCERT geography syllabus level) and are reliable. GI-tagged products listed are real, registered GI tags verified against the CGPDTM/Wikipedia GI registry — but the full GI list has 600+ entries and this file lists only the most well-known 1-3 per state, not the complete registry. Livestock and fisheries entries describe well-known regional specializations (e.g. 'major dairy state', 'marine fisheries coast') rather than precise headcounts or tonnage, which require Livestock Census / CMFRI data not held in general knowledge.
_meta.NOT_INCLUDED: District-level breakdowns, street/locality data, exact production tonnages, exact livestock counts. These require pulling from data.gov.in, Livestock Census, Agmarknet, and CMFRI/state fisheries datasets — see the ingestion plan sent separately for source URLs.
_meta.how_to_extend: Use each state's official Department of Agriculture / Department of Animal Husbandry / State Fisheries portal, plus data.gov.in datasets, to add district-level rows under each state using the same schema keys.
